_conventions: Per-bone rotations in degrees, body frame, right-wing convention, chained shoulder->elbow->wrist (local to the parent). sweep + = tip aft, elev + = tip up, twist + = leading edge up. scale_x compresses the chord. Targets: refs/kinematics/poses.md and the photo fits (analysis/photo_fits).

glide.target: full-spread glide as photographed: photo fits P01/P04 arm 7-11 deg aft, hand -7..+5; dihedral 6 deg (estimated); tail partly spread

flap_top.target: tip +12..+16 cm above the shoulder (+0.6..0.7 BL), 1.3-2.9 cm aft of it; humerus +80-90 deg (Ben-Gida 2013 Fig 4, Stalnov 2015 Fig 3, Dial 1991)

flap_mid.target: span 1.0, tip at shoulder level, chord pitched 13 deg LE-down (Ben-Gida 2013 Fig 5b)

flap_bottom.target: tip -14.5..-16.5 cm below the shoulder, ~6.3 cm aft of it (Ben-Gida 2013 Fig 4, Stalnov 2015 Fig 3); wing nearly straight, so top-view span ~0.39-0.50 of full

upstroke.target: mid-upstroke span 0.50 of mid-downstroke (0.40-0.60; robin proxy, Hedenstrom 2006); hand swept 45-60 deg; wrists adducted (Dial 1991)

upstroke_top.target: late upstroke: span recovering 0.5 -> 0.7, humerus rising toward +80 deg (Dial 1991, Tobalske 1995)

bound.target: bound of intermittent flight: wings held tight to the body (Tobalske 2011), span 0.12-0.20 of full; humerus 28 mm < forearm 34 mm puts the folded wrist ~0.7 cm ahead of the shoulder, so the tips reach ~0.86 L (between the tail base 0.68 L and tip; perched skins 0.94-1.06); tail furled
